records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the fourth quarter ended December 31, 2022, revenue was $2.07 billion, a $184 million or 10 percent increase compared to the third quarter of 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Growing demand for completion equipment and greater progress on the segment’s growing backlog of offshore projects drove improved results.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Accelerating demand in international markets was partially offset by lingering supply chain disruptions, which delayed product deliveries.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The average price per barrel of West Texas Intermediate Crude was $94.81 in 2022, an increase of 39% over the average price for 2021 of $67.99 per barrel.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the year ended December 31, 2022, the Company reported an operating profit of $264 million compared to an operating loss of $134 million in 2021, and net income attributable to the Company of $155 million, or $0.39 per fully diluted share compared to a net loss of $250 million or $0.65 per share during 2021.
